parts.t: Large and Cozy 1 bed + den top floor unit now available in Langley’s College Court! Located moments away from Kwantlen University, Public Transit, as well as the future Langley Sky Train Line, this unit is situated perfectly for easy access wherever it is you’re going! Additional features include brand new S/S appliances, 1 underground parking stall, and in-suite laundry. Perfect for students & first-time home buyers!

blocks.text: Listed by Royal LePage Northstar Realty (S. Surrey)
